The supplied same-candidate evidence manifest hashes cleanly (40/40) and records 546 Python tests, 6 host tests, 8 editor tests, 12 projection tests, syntax checks, and Chromium 60/60 passing. Those results do not cover the new verification/invalidation interleaving counterexample.

The two excluded generated bundles were not read: recovery2 candidate bytes match manifest for `tools/studio/static/workbench.js` and `tools/studio/static/workbench.css`; evidence `rebuild.json` records byte-identical source rebuild output for both.

The fixed external Stable Gate is expressly post-report and was not executed; no merge, Stable promotion, or personal UX acceptance is claimed. MA-10 is therefore blocked independently of the P1 correction.
